recentItems.title: Broken Karaoke Seasons 1~3 Compilation! 🤩🎤 | Big City Greens, Kiff & More | Disney Channel
recentItems.description:
Get ready to sing along with every Broken Karaoke hit in one epic compilation! In Broken Karaoke, your favorite Disney characters take the stage and sing hilarious parodies of iconic pop songs!

Feature episodes: 
00:00 Queen of Nice
Tilly Green doesn't want to be the Queen of Mean, but instead wants to be the Queen of Nice!

01:15 Stuck At Home
Cricket, Tilly, Gramma, and Bill make the best out of being stuck at home!

03:15 Stuck At Home Lyric Video
Cricket, Tilly, Gramma, and Bill make the best out of being stuck at home, LYRIC STYLE! Watch the lyric version of the ZOMBIES 2 Flesh & Bone parody.

05:15 Deck the Halls
'Tis the season for an epic crossover! Fa la la la la la la la la! Dr. Doofenshmirtz, Baymax, Launchpad, Anne Boonchuy, and Tilly Green sing their own version of Deck the Halls!

06:00 Deck the Halls Emoji Lyric Video
Emojified Dr. Doof just wants to belt out a Christmas tune, but he keeps getting interrupted!

07:32 Call Me Mabel
Mabel is looking for some summer romance! Any takers? Anyone? No seriously, anyone...Check out Mabel from Gravity Falls singing "Call Me Mabel."

10:02 Where Are All the Monsters?
Check out Cricket from Big City Greens singing "Where Are All the Monsters," a parody of China Anne McClain's Halloween song "Calling All the Monsters!"

11:37 Where Are All the Monsters? Lyric Video
Sing along to the lyric version of China Anne McClain's song "Calling All the Monsters" parody "Where Are All the Monsters" starring Cricket from Big City Greens!

13:06 Goin' Back Out
The Greens are back with a parody to Break This Down from Descendants 3! Cricket, Tilly, Gramma, and Bill are Goin' Back Out!

15:33 Santa Gave My Grandson Coal for Christmas
When Cricket is distraught to receive coal from Santa Claus, a furious Gramma Alice journeys to the North Pole on a mission for vengeance!

17:33 Monster Man
It's Halloween story time! Tilly tells Cricket a Halloween tale of the Monster Man!

19:33 Scratch's Scary Holiday Song
Scratch wishes you happy holidays through this classic holiday song "We Wish You a Merry Christmas" with a spooky twist!

21:33 Sidekicks
Gather around, sidekicks! This is a no-protagonist zone! Where would Cricket, Anne, Luz, and Molly be without their trusty sidekicks? This is the sidekicks anthem!

23:33 Goin' Back Out Lyric Video
It's a Broken Karaoke lyric video! The Greens are back with a Descendants 3 Parody. Check out the Greens singing "Goin' Back Out", the sequel to "Stuck at Home!"

25:50 Sidekicks Lyric Video
Gather around, sidekicks! No main character energy here. It's a Broken Karaoke lyric video! It's time we show some love to our beloved sidekicks. This is the sidekicks anthem!

27:19 We're Going Offline
In this cover of the catchy bop, "Ain't No Doubt About It" from ZOMBIES 3, Cricket tries to convince Remy to unplug from technology and enjoy a day outside!

29:19 I Just Wanna Eat Bread
It's a Broken Karaoke! Scratch and Molly from the Ghost and Molly McGee are back with a ZOMBIES 3 Parody! Check out "I Just Wanna Eat Bread," a parody of "Exceptional Zed."

31:19 Ways We Feel Anxious
In this cover of "Ways to be Wicked" Gloria, Libby, Candace, and Marcy form a girl band called "The Stress Girlz" to sing a cathartic anthem about how they deal with anxiety.

33:19 Born to Be Strange
In this cover of "Born to be Brave" from "High School Musical: The Musical: The Series," Tilly Green sings an anthem that celebrates the inner weirdo of your favorite characters.

35:19 Evil as Can Be
The Disney Channel's greatest animated villains gather together to sing a power anthem about how good it is to be evil!

37:19 I'll Wear Them All
In this parody of the hit "High School Musical 3" song "I Want it All" Kristine teaches Hailey Banks about just how fun wearing hats can be.

39:19 Squirrels Just Wanna Have Fun
In this parody of Cyndi Lauper's "Girls Just Wanna Have Fun," Kiff sings about how squirrels are always down for a nutty good time.
